CHAPTER 739 Donation Bins 739.01 Definitions 739.02 Permit Required 739.03 Application; Fee 739.04 Number of Bins 739.05 Maintenance of Bins 739.06 Information to be Displayed 739.07 No Dumping in or Near a Donation Bin 739.08 Enforcement 739.09 Violations; Penalties 739.01 Definitions (a) As used in this Chapter: (1) "Donation Bin" means any receptacle placed outdoors which is intended or used to receive donations to a bona-fide religious or charitable organization of used or unwanted articles of clothing, books, games, toys, CDs/DVDs and/or other small household goods. (2) "Charitable Organization" shall mean a corporation, association, trust, church, foundation or other lawful entity which is currently recognized by the Internal Revenue Service as a tax-exempt charitable or religious organization under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code.
